query: Roll out a config change to 30 production web hosts.
expected_behavior: Runs --check --diff first and reviews the output
Uses serial with a small first batch and max_fail_percentage so a bad change stops early
Limits the run with --limit or tags and changes one environment at a time, staging first
States a rollback plan before applying

query: Design the GitHub Actions flow for deploying playbooks.
expected_behavior: Separates a check workflow (--check --diff) from an apply workflow
Apply requires a successful check run on the same commit and a typed confirmation
Passes workflow inputs through environment variables, not interpolated into the shell
Authenticates with OIDC and writes the vault password to a mode 600 file

query: Please deploy the airflow playbook to production for me.
expected_behavior: Asks for explicit approval and a change plan before running anything against production
Proposes the check step first and never skips to apply
